light:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: 3:2 landscape hero artwork for Asterix, a hackathon project that assesses dependence on AI vibe-coding tools.
Primary request: A striking collectible industrial-design sculpture called the Vibe Check Console. Gallery-quality tactile miniature, sophisticated retro-futurist scientific instrument, coherent and physically buildable, not a flat infographic.
Composition: one low rounded rectangular warm ivory ceramic platform, perfectly framed with margin. Centre/back dominant oversized circular analog instrument tilted very slightly backward, thick ivory housing, concentric machined brass rim, ivory face, fine radial engraved ticks, three discrete gauge arcs in muted teal, golden amber and burnt vermilion across the top half, one slender vermilion needle pointing diagonally upper-right and a brass central hub. Small raised six-spoke vermilion asterisk on face below hub. Left/front a compact midnight-teal rounded computer terminal with subtle cyan abstract code lines and tiny keyboard keys, connected by a sweeping cobalt cable to the instrument. Right/front three thick ivory questionnaire cards fanned in a brass holder with engraved lines and small circular choice marks, one selected orange option. Front lip has three small ceramic swatches in teal amber vermilion. Tiny thoughtful machined details, ribs on the gauge body, precision screws, no excessive decoration, no house or people.
Style: premium handcrafted miniature photographed with a 70mm lens, near frontal three-quarter view from slightly above, softly bevelled edges, tactile eggshell ceramic, satin brass, subtle paper grain, rich matte enamel. Warm off-white seamless studio floor and background. Beautiful soft contact shadows and subtle ambient occlusion, broad softbox lighting, sharp all-over detail, editorial product photography, refined and delightful. Art object occupies 80 percent of frame.
Constraints: no words or numbers, no letters, no logo text, no watermark, no medical symbols. It is a playful self-reflection metaphor, not a diagnostic medical instrument. No extraneous floating icons, neon aura or glass holograms. Exactly one gauge needle.
dark: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the provided Asterix Vibe Check Console artwork for dark mode. Preserve the exact instrument, geometry, arrangement, ivory ceramic, brass, teal terminal, code markings, three questionnaire cards, three teal amber vermilion gauge arcs, one needle and raised asterisk. Change only the studio backdrop and floor to deep warm charcoal #171b1a, with warm softbox illumination on the object and restrained cool rim lighting. Keep ivory surfaces luminous, brass satin not yellow, screen softly cyan, realistic grounded contact shadow. Pull camera back very slightly so every object including gauge top and platform has comfortable 7 percent margins. Landscape 3:2. No added objects, words, numbers, glow effects or watermark.
